_source: Script lines follow Hajin's morning script (team Doc). Other A-questions come from the assessment sheet tab 03 (data/team/*/03_*.csv); triage lines follow tab 06 'Recommended System Action'. After-visit lines follow Hajin's after-visit script (softened: doctor only, no stop/skip order).

reminder.en: Good {greeting}, {name}! It's time for your {slot} medicine.

A01.en: Please tell me when you've taken it.
A01.ko: 약 드시고 나면 저한테 말씀해 주세요.

reminder2.en: Just a reminder: it's time for your {slot} medicine. Did you take it?

taken_ack.en: Okay, I'll mark your {slot} medicine as taken.

A03.en: Is there a reason you couldn't take it? For example, you forgot, it felt uncomfortable, or you ran out.
A03.ko: 약을 못 드신 이유가 있나요? 잊으셨거나, 불편하셨거나, 약이 떨어졌나요?

A04.en: How are you feeling today? Is anything bothering you?
A04.ko: 오늘은 몸이 좀 어떠세요? 불편한 곳은 없으세요?

A05.en: I see. Did you feel it before taking your medicine?

close_ok.en: Thank you. I've noted it. Have a good day.

close_t03.en: Got it. I'll write that down. Please sit and rest for now, and call your doctor if it continues.
close_t03.ko: 알겠어요. 적어둘게요. 우선 앉아서 쉬시고, 계속되면 병원에 연락해 보세요.

close_flag.en: I've recorded this and I'll let your doctor know. Please contact your doctor soon about it.
close_flag.ko: 기록했어요. 의사 선생님께 알려드릴게요. 빨리 병원에 연락해 보세요.

close_caregiver.en: Noted. I'll let your caregiver know.

new_med_review.en: Your new medicine is being reviewed by your doctor together with your other medicines. They will contact you.
new_med_review.ko: 새로 받으신 약을 의사 선생님이 다른 약들과 함께 확인하고 계세요. 곧 연락드릴 거예요.

T01.en: This could be an emergency. Please call 119 now. I'm alerting your family and doctor.
T01.ko: 응급 상황일 수 있어요. 지금 119에 전화하세요. 가족과 의사 선생님께 알릴게요.

not_understood.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
not_understood.ko: 죄송해요, 잘 못 들었어요. 다시 말씀해 주시겠어요?

missed_forgot.en: That's okay. I've noted it, and I'll remind you at the next time.
missed_forgot.ko: 괜찮아요. 적어두고 다음 시간에 다시 알려드릴게요.

missed_discomfort.en: I've noted that the medicine felt uncomfortable. I'll let your doctor know.
missed_discomfort.ko: 약이 불편하셨다고 적어둘게요. 의사 선생님께 알려드릴게요.

report_sent.en: I'll send your doctor a report of your medicines and how you've been feeling before the visit.
report_sent.ko: 진료 전에 복용 중인 약과 그동안의 상태를 정리해서 의사 선생님께 보내 드릴게요.

rx_photo_ask.en: Could you take a photo of the prescription so I can check it?
rx_photo_ask.ko: 확인할 수 있게 처방전 사진을 찍어 주시겠어요?

rx_found.en: I found a medicine called {drug}. Is that the name on your prescription?
rx_found.ko: {drug}라는 약을 찾았어요. 처방전에 있는 이름이 맞나요?

rx_unreadable.en: Sorry, I couldn't read the prescription. Could you take the photo again, a little closer?
rx_unreadable.ko: 죄송해요, 처방전을 읽지 못했어요. 조금 더 가까이에서 다시 찍어 주시겠어요?

rx_retry.en: Okay. Could you take the photo again?

rx_risk.en: {drug} may affect kidney function, especially in people with chronic kidney disease like you.
rx_risk.ko: {drug}은(는) 만성 콩팥병이 있는 분의 콩팥 기능에 영향을 줄 수 있어요.

rx_review.en: {drug} may not suit your other medicines.
rx_review.ko: {drug}이(가) 다른 약과 맞지 않을 수 있어요.

rx_ok.en: Thank you. I've added {drug} to your medicine list.

rx_advice.en: Please check with your doctor before taking the new medicine. I'll help you share your medication list and kidney condition with your doctor.
rx_advice.ko: 새 약을 드시기 전에 의사 선생님과 꼭 확인해 주세요. 복용 중인 약 목록과 콩팥 상태를 의사 선생님께 공유해 드릴게요.

ask_doctor.en: I can't tell you to stop or change a medicine. Please check with your doctor first. I'll let your doctor know you asked.
ask_doctor.ko: 약을 끊거나 바꾸라고 말씀드릴 수는 없어요. 먼저 의사 선생님과 확인해 주세요. 물어보셨다고 의사 선생님께 알려드릴게요.
